request: Build a purchase request module: each request has a title, a needed-by date and the requester name, with request lines for the item description and quantity, and it goes Draft, Submitted, Approved.

outcome.renderedDiff:
New record type "Purchase request" with 4 fields:
  - State (one of "Draft", "Submitted", "Approved", required)
  - Title (text, required)
  - Needed by (date)
  - Requester name (text)
  It gets its own menu entry "Purchase request" with a list, a record page and a form.
  People who can use the rest of the application can create, change, archive and restore Purchase request records.
New line table "Request lines" on Purchase request:
  - Line number (whole number, required)
  - Item description (text, required)
  - Quantity (whole number)
New lifecycle for Purchase request. Records start at "Draft".
  - Submit changes "Draft" to "Submitted" after confirmation.
  - Approve changes "Submitted" to "Approved" after confirmation.

Stored data: 2 new tables, addForeignKey, 3 new indexes. Nothing already stored is changed or removed.
Rolling back hides this change again and keeps every record entered under it.

reasons: purchase request: line not created: ModuleRuntimeInterpreterError: operation precondition does not hold on the parent image
